write.prompt: It has been suggested that all secondary schools should run a compulsory first-aid course. To what extent do you agree or disagree? For this task, write only the introduction and one topic sentence for each body paragraph, each followed by one WHY/HOW sentence.
write.taskVi: mở bài 30–50 từ (bối cảnh + thesis nêu mức đồng ý) và hai câu chủ đề thân bài, mỗi câu kèm một câu WHY / HOW. Mở rộng: tự lập kế hoạch, không dùng câu hỏi hỗ trợ.
mustUse: ít nhất một câu bị động
write.modelAfterSubmit:
Mở bài (45 từ): Today, many students can solve difficult equations but would not know what to do if a classmate suddenly fainted. In my view, every secondary school should offer a short compulsory first-aid course, as long as it does not replace core subjects.

Thân bài 1: The main reason is that basic first aid can save lives before professional help arrives. If simple skills such as stopping bleeding are taught to every student, someone nearby will always know how to act in an emergency.

Thân bài 2: Such a course would not take much time away from academic subjects. Most first-aid skills can be taught in a few practical sessions, which could be held during existing biology or physical education lessons.

selfCheck.vi: Thesis trả lời "to what extent" (đồng ý hoàn toàn, phần nào, hay có điều kiện)?
Mở bài không chứa lý do chi tiết của thân bài?
Bị động đủ be + V3 (is taught, can be held)?
Mỗi câu chủ đề gắn rõ với thesis?
Phân biệt compulsory / optional, course / lesson?

praiseEn: Plan ready — your essay has a strong backbone!
